description.en: Desktop notification and message alerts for DSH: a system reminder with sound and a tab-title marker when the agent needs your input (approval, plan review, question) or a reply finishes in the background; volume and zh/en language in Settings.
description.zh: 消息提醒 / 桌面通知：模型需要你操作（审批、方案确认、提问）或后台回复完成时，弹出系统通知与提示音，并标记标签页标题；可在设置页开关、调节音量、切换中英文通知语言。
